body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). The remaining context-handoff test suites and support helpers (recovery-exception.test.mjs, continue-cli-support.mjs, continue-ownership-bytes.test.mjs, doctor.test.mjs, supervise-cli-support.mjs) manually invoke mkdtempSync with uncleaned leaks or manual try/finally blocks, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In packages/context-handoff/adapter-test/recovery-exception.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update fixturePaths(t) to accept t and allocate dir via tmp(t, 'recovery-exception-').
   - Update tests to accept t from test(...) and pass t to fixturePaths(t).
2. In packages/context-handoff/test/continue-cli-support.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update fixture(t, prefix = 'handoff-continue-') to accept t and use tmp(t, prefix).
3. In packages/context-handoff/test/continue-ownership-bytes.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update scratch(t) to accept t and allocate via tmp(t, 'adlc-ownership-').
   - Update test declarations to accept t and pass to scratch(t).
4. In packages/context-handoff/test/doctor.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update scratch(t) to accept t and use tmp(t, 'handoff-doctor-').
   - Update test declarations to accept t and pass to scratch(t).
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
5. In packages/context-handoff/test/supervise-cli-support.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update fixture(t, prefix = 'handoff-supervise-') to accept t and allocate root via tmp(t, prefix).
6. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove all 5 packages/context-handoff/* entries from the ALLOWLIST set (completely eradicates packages/context-handoff from allowlist).
7. Verification:
   - npm test -w packages/context-handoff exits 0.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -c 'finally' packages/context-handoff/test/doctor.test.mjs returns 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 All 5 context-handoff test files contain 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in any of the 5 context-handoff test files.
- AC3 grep -E 'packages/context-handoff/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.
- AC4 npm test -w packages/context-handoff exits 0.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(context-handoff): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit across remaining context-handoff tests
